headline: Rockstar's GTA 6 Sales Top $2B in Record Launch, Industry Estimates Show
summary: Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto VI has broken entertainment records as sales surpassed $2 billion, according to industry estimates, marking the end of a 13-year wait.
why: Rockstar Games is a major publishing label of Take-Two Interactive. Landmark game launches in the entertainment software sector can generate billions of dollars in high-margin revenue.

impacts.name: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.
impacts.why: Record-breaking release sales directly enhance revenue and earnings performance for the parent company.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
